title: block-qa/v1 — devil's-advocate (da-axis) extension
description: Forward-compatible (pre-adopted) extension of the block-qa/v1 QaCriterionEntry for the adversarial devil's-advocate axis emitted by local/devils-advocate-watcher. These optional fields are additive: a validator that does not yet know them must ignore them (passthrough), and a validator that does know them applies the constraints below. The canonical producing types live in litlfred/folio-assistant schemas/block-qa.ts; this file is the qou-side pre-adoption contract.

daScope.description: Refutation scope per AGENTS.md 'Before declaring refuted'. 'limited' = this construction ALONE fails as stated (default). 'structural' = cannot hold in any closure; PERMITTED ONLY when referee_argument/rebuttal cite a proved invariant (parity/sign, dimension/degree/orbit-count bound, Lean-proved impossibility, entropy/precision bound).

daRuling.description: Adjudicator's verdict on a single objection after the block's own text/Lean/refs/corpus-grep were given the chance to rebut. surviving = no rebuttal found; rebutted = block defeats it; partial = block mitigates but does not fully defeat it.

daVerdict.description: Block-level rollup (criterion id da-referee-verdict). clean = all objections rebutted; survivable-objection = >=1 partial, 0 surviving; open-objection = >=1 surviving.

daCriterionEntryExtension.description: Fields ADDED to the existing QaCriterionEntry for da-* criteria. All optional; combine with the existing field_hash/result/severity/evidence/reviewer/reviewed_at/reviewed_sha/notes.

referee_argument.description: The objection stated in the referee's voice (1-3 sentences). On a da-referee-verdict rollup entry this holds the strongest objection.

rebuttal.description: What rebuts the objection, or 'none — survived because <why>'. For structural scope, must name the proved invariant.

allOf.description: result must agree with ruling on finding entries.
result must agree with verdict on the rollup entry.
structural scope requires a non-empty rebuttal naming the invariant.

daCriteria.description: The da-* criterion ids the devils-advocate axis emits. Each is agent-only (reviewer.kind = 'agent'); none has a script reviewer. default_severity guides the rollup.

da-false-claim.summary: Stated proposition is mathematically false (counterexample / quantifier slip / failing special case).

da-vacuous.summary: True but content-free: ': True := trivial', self-assuming projection, tautology, or trivializing hypothesis.

da-circular.summary: Derivation assumes its conclusion: back-fitted target, smuggled calibration, self-referential justification.

da-overclaim.summary: Conclusion stronger than the argument supports: scope-limited negative as structural, fitted-as-derived, conditional-as-proved, approximate-as-absolute.

da-hidden-dof.summary: Undisclosed free parameter: 4th calibration, off-menu coefficient, constant with no canonical-chain origin.

da-non-sequitur.summary: Logical gap: step B does not follow from step A; 'therefore' with a missing lemma.

da-lean-narrative-divergence.summary: Lean proves something weaker/different/vacuously-implied vs the .md claim (proof-statement-integrity).

da-citation-misuse.summary: Cited reference (cites[] or -- Ref:) does not contain / is mis-attributed for the invoked result.

da-definitional-ambiguity.summary: Key term undefined / multiple incompatible readings / 'the unique X' without uniqueness / implicit regime or base ring.

da-empirical-fragility.summary: Numerical match inside fit noise / cherry-picked precision / hidden cross-anchor swing / stale vs current q0 pin.

da-physical-implausibility.summary: Physics claim a domain expert rejects: wrong units, broken conservation, contradiction with a measurement.

da-reproducibility.summary: Backing compute/witness irreproducible / stale (scriptHash or scriptCommitSha drift) / value contradicts prose approximate.

da-referee-verdict.summary: Block-level rollup; carries the 'verdict' field + the strongest objection in 'referee_argument'.
